prior_information: Earlier Swiss and five-medicine L04AC07 outcomes known. Ustekinumab metadata identities inspected; new label inventories, bounds, policy outcomes and baseline transfer counts not computed.
question: Can one unmodified finite-completion kernel preserve determinate judgments and certify single-field gains across Swiss snapshots and a new European label-inventory question? How do bound-based, degree-based and random acquisition orders compare at equal field budgets?
heldout_selection: All exact L04AC05 EMA entries in the frozen metadata. Cohort chosen for source-format and target-question transfer; not randomly selected. No exclusions based on available documents or favorable routes.
label_extraction: Use unchanged V25 section-5 heading/title/end boundaries and route patterns. Preserve unavailable document or incomplete/unrecognized fields as unavailable; account for every medicine. Confirm staged ATC against complete SmPC ATC-code fields.
query_population: Ordered pairs of different cohort medicines and each source-documented route. Target inventory must be complete before noncoverage can be asserted. Query keys frozen before masking, as in the earlier EMA transfer task.
kernel_assumptions: Fixed query keys and option sets; immutable records; all admitted nonempty field values enumerated; independent possibilities for distinct fields; shared field revelations propagated to all affected questions; missing witnesses stay unavailable. Bounds conditional on modeled possibilities and a successfully acquired nonempty exact field.
masked_budget_evaluation: Mask all eligible explicit parenteral Swiss fields simultaneously and all complete EMA target inventories. Never expose held-out actual values to selectors. Recompute min/max bounds after each revelation. Compare adaptive bound-first order, adaptive unresolved-degree order and 128 seeded random orders. Equal unit field costs; no human-time claim.
reference_checks: Independent SQL expression for every path and aggregate; finite possible-world controls; sharpness via explicit attaining completions; preservation under valid revelations; fully restored outputs must match original.
temporal_transfer: Run the unchanged kernel on the baseline and June Swiss snapshots; report overlap and changed candidate keys. This is a dependent temporal replay, not independent-team replication.
acceptance: Complete accounting and output consistency, regardless of favorable policy advantage. All arms and all budgets retained.
